p: concubines: To whom belonged no dowry.
perfect with the LORD his God: He did not serve God with a pure heart.
Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites: Who was also called Molech in 1Ki 11:7. See also 2Ki 23:10.
abomination of Moab: Thus the scripture calls whatever man reveres and serves as God.
this is done of thee: That you have forsaken me and worshipped idols.
tribe to thy son for David: Because the tribes of Judah and Benjamin had their possessions mixed, they are here taken as one tribe.
seed in Edom: Of the king of Edom's stock.
fled: Thus God reserved this idolater as scourge to punish his people's sins.
found great favour in the sight: God brought him honour, that his power might be more able to compass his enterprises against Solomon's house.
fled from his lord Hadadezer king: When David had defeated Hadadezer and his army.
and reigned in Damascus: That is, the men whom he had gathered to him.
ruler over all the charge of: He was overseer of Solomon's works for the tribe of Ephraim and Manasseh.
rent it in twelve pieces: By these visible signs the prophets would more deeply print their message into the hearts of those to whom they were sent.
light alway before me in Jerusalem: He refers to the Messiah, who would be the bright star that would shine through all the world.
for this afflict the seed of: For this idolatry that Solomon has committed.
but not for ever: For the whole spiritual kingdom was restored in the Messiah.
book of the acts of Solomon: Which it is thought was lost in their captivity.
